_comment: Single source of truth for verify_report.py and for anyone writing Prime copy. Edit here, not in prose.
banned_tropes: they don't want you to know
_competitor_brands_note: Names spoken in the ad may be quoted verbatim in Phases 1-3 (that is reporting what was said). They must never appear in Phases 4-6 Prime copy, including as an unlicensed endorsement.

approved_price_context.39.97: Buy 1 Get 1 (2 bottles, 60 capsules) — $19.99/bottle, 1-month supply at 2 capsules/day
approved_price_context.79.97: Buy 2 Get 2 (4 bottles, 120 capsules) — $19.99/bottle, 2-month supply + free shipping
approved_price_context.99.98: Buy 3 Get 3 (6 bottles, 180 capsules) — $16.66/bottle, 3-month supply + free shipping
approved_price_context.19.99: per-bottle price on Buy 1 Get 1 and Buy 2 Get 2
approved_price_context.16.66: per-bottle price on Buy 3 Get 3 only
approved_price_context.1.33: approx cost per day on Buy 1 Get 1 ($39.97 / 30 days)
approved_price_context.1.11: approx cost per day on Buy 3 Get 3 ($99.98 / 90 days)
approved_price_context.250: FREE $250 Amazon gift card — Halloween Sale gift (website, Oct 2026)
approved_price_context.50 / 110 / 150: cart-reward thresholds: free shipping over $50, free Astaxanthin over $110, free Magnesium over $150 (see current_offer)

product_facts.name: Prime Ingredients NMN Ultimate 10-in-1
product_facts.dose_text: 1,000 mg active NMN complex per serving
product_facts.serving: 1-2 vegetarian capsules daily (supply claims assume 2 capsules/day)
product_facts.supply_note: 30 capsules per bottle. At 2 capsules/day: 1 bottle = 15 days, B1G1 = 1 month, B2G2 = 2 months, B3G3 = 3 months.

approved_claim_language: supports the body's natural NAD+ pathway
helps you feel more like yourself
structure_function_note: Every Prime claim must describe support of a normal body structure or function. If a line implies the product acts on a disease, rewrite it or cut the beat and note the cut under Phase 4.
_similarity_note: Phase 4 must preserve the competitor's BEAT STRUCTURE, cadence and timing while using Prime's own wording. Adapted lines at or above this word-overlap ratio with the source line are copied expression, not adapted structure — rewrite them.
_price_note: All bundle prices reconfirmed by the user on 2026-10-15 as valid during the Halloween Sale.
_substantiated_note: User-confirmed 2026-10-15: these are on the live product page and may be used in Prime copy. Use the exact numbers; never inflate them.

current_offer.headline: Up to 75% off
current_offer.wording_rule: Always 'Up to 75% off' — never a flat '75% off'.
current_offer.cta_rule: Every Prime CTA during the Halloween window states 'Up to 75% off' AND the free $250 Amazon gift card; a bundle price may follow.

_calendar_note: Q4 Longevity Marketing Campaign Schedule (NMN & Astaxanthin, 10-15 day early activation windows). Windows overlap; the offer for each campaign after Halloween is not yet confirmed — ask before writing offer copy for it.
